title: Fulham Pier opened at Craven Cottage
summary: Fulham FC published that Fulham Pier was open on 6 June 2025, marking the public opening of a riverside destination integrated with the redeveloped Riverside Stand at Craven Cottage.
observed_change: A redeveloped stadium riverside stand and associated public-facing food, leisure, event, and Thames-side spaces entered documented public use.
architect: Populous with Fulham FC Riverside Stand and Fulham Pier project team
project_type: stadium stand redevelopment and riverside public destination

geometry_precision: Approximate site point, not a measured stand footprint, concourse, riverside walkway, retail unit, hotel, spa, or Thames Path segment.
limitations: The event records the public opening announcement for Fulham Pier; phased Riverside Stand works, matchday use, tenant openings, hotel and spa operations, and detailed public-right-of-way arrangements may have separate dates.
duplicate_check_note: Searched manual corpus and prior tmp/subagents files for 'Fulham Pier', 'Riverside Stand', 'Craven Cottage', 'fulham-pier-is-now-open', and proposed event_id on 2026-05-18; no existing London architecture milestone match was found.

title: WEST Youth Zone opened in White City
summary: OnSide records that WEST, the Hammersmith and Fulham Youth Zone at EdCity in White City, opened to young people on 21 April 2024.
observed_change: A purpose-built youth-zone building within the EdCity development entered public community use for young people.
architect: EdCity, OnSide, Hammersmith and Fulham Council, Ark, and WEST Youth Zone project team
geometry_source: Curated project point from WEST Youth Zone / EdCity White City location.
geometry_precision: Approximate building point, not a measured sports hall, climbing wall, studio, cafe, Babyzone, entrance, or EdCity phase boundary.
limitations: The event records opening to young people; prior royal visit, opening-party activity, wider EdCity school, homes, nursery, adult-learning, office, and later operating statistics are separate evidence paths.
duplicate_check_note: Searched manual corpus and prior tmp/subagents files for 'WEST Youth Zone', 'Hammersmith and Fulham Youth Zone', 'OnSide Youth Zone', 'EdCity', source URL, and proposed event_id on 2026-05-18; EdCity school and related wider development entries exist, but no matching WEST Youth Zone opening event was found.
